_meta.source: Statistics South Africa — Census 2022; General Household Survey (GHS)
_meta.notes: All three records are CENSUS 2022 values (P0301.4, 2023-10-10) and keep Census definitions: piped water = INSIDE the dwelling (59.7%; 82.4% inside dwelling or yard); electricity = main source of energy for LIGHTING (94.7%); formal dwellings = Census dwelling-type classification (88.5%). Previously stored values (63.0%, 91.2%, 80.9%) did not match the Census release and were corrected. GHS 2025 (P0318, published 2026-05-26) is a different survey with different definitions (e.g. formal dwellings 84.2%, electricity access 90.6% per GCIS summary of the GHS); these are NOT substituted into these Census records. A separate GHS-based series would need new records/registry entries — owner decision. REVIEW: historical points not re-verified — water 2001 (42.3); electricity 2001, 2011 (85.4), 2016 (88.2); formal 2001 (65.2), 2016 (78.1). The 2016 points come from the Community Survey, not a census. 2011 formal (77.6) is derived from Stats SA's reported 10.9-point increase to 88.5; 2011 water (46.3) and 1996 electricity/formal (58.1/65.1) are from Stats SA statements as reported by SAnews/Polity/Mail & Guardian. Census 2022 had an estimated ~31% net undercount (PES); Stats SA considers the data fit for use and has said it will not revise it.
_meta.public_notes: All three indicators are Census 2022 values (Stats SA P0301.4, released 10 October 2023) and use Census definitions: piped water means water inside the dwelling, electricity means the main source of energy for lighting, and formal dwellings follow the Census dwelling-type classification. The 2016 points come from the Community Survey, not a census. Some earlier points (2011 water, and 1996 electricity and formal dwellings) come from Stats SA statements as reported in the news media. Census 2022 had an estimated net undercount of about 31%; Stats SA considers the data fit for use and has said it will not revise the results.

statistics.title: Homes with piped water inside
statistics.description: Percentage of households with piped (tap) water inside their dwelling in Census 2022 (46.3% in 2011). A broader 82.4% had piped water either inside the dwelling or inside the yard. Access remains uneven: 20.5% of households in Limpopo and 19.5% in the Eastern Cape had no access to piped water at all.

statistics.title: Homes using electricity for lighting
statistics.description: Percentage of households using electricity as their main source of energy for lighting in Census 2022 (58.1% in 1996). This measures the main lighting source, not a metered or grid connection, and not reliability: load-shedding and tariff pressures still affect effective access.

statistics.title: Households in formal dwellings
statistics.description: Percentage of households living in formal dwellings (brick/concrete houses, flats, townhouses, cluster and semi-detached houses, and formal backyard units) in Census 2022, up from 65.1% in 1996. About 8.1% lived in informal dwellings (13.6% in 2011) and 3.1% in traditional dwellings.
